dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: Hmm, this world seems to operate on different rules. My Tzitzimimeh are unable to unleash their full power.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: So, even if I want to help you, there are some limits on my ability to fight indefinitely.

dialogues.speaker: Citlali
dialogues.text: You should take a break. Do you need a drink? A pillow, maybe a light novel...? Don't be shy... Really, you're sure you don't want anything? Heh, you're so low-maintenance...
